planReference.title: Tirumala 7 — 50′ × 40′ Three-Floor Corner Home with Full-Span Atrium Sunroof & East Kitchen Setback

coordinate_system.pdf_x_axis: feet east of west plot line (0..50)
coordinate_system.pdf_y_axis: feet south of north plot line (0..40)

wall_thickness_mm.note: Follows Tirumala 5/6 custom-plan convention (WALL = 120 mm, 60 mm each side of nominal wall axes).

light_shaft.ground_floor: Full-span double-height atrium from Home ICU south wall (y=25′) right up to the Staircase (y=33′) over the Dining Hall
light_shaft.first_floor: 13′ × 8′ slab opening (Open to below) with frameless glass guards on all open edges
light_shaft.second_floor: 13′ × 8′ raised architectural glazed sunroof directly above the dining atrium with travertine upstand curb and safety glass guard

stair.type: U-turn stair climbing south, west, north

axes.X_geo: Increases Eastward (0.000 m at West boundary -> 15.240 m at East frontage; 50 ft)
axes.Y_geo: Increases Northward (0.000 m at South boundary -> 12.192 m at North boundary; 40 ft)
axes.Z_geo: Increases Upward (0.000 m at road NGL; house +0.300 m; car porch below house by the adjustable porch drop)

coordinate_system.origin_description: Southwest plot corner (SW) at Natural Ground Level (NGL ±0.000 m); FloorForge local/scene origin (0, 0, 0) is Southeast plot corner (SE) at Ground Floor FFL (+0.300 m)

excluded_temporary_objects.reason: Parked white hatchback car along the north road frontage is temporary and explicitly excluded from the 3D scene and site plan.

adjoining_south_and_west.note: Grass replaces the adjoining and same-block placeholder houses. Road-opposite reference landmarks remain.

notes: Three-floor 50' x 40' north-east corner home with a full-span double-height dining atrium (x 20.5-30.5 ft, y 25-33 ft) and 13.5' x 8' raised glazed sunroof (x 20.5-34 ft, y 25-33 ft) spanning from the Home ICU/Dining wall right up to the U-turn staircase. Ground floor includes a 3' east setback (x=47 ft) along the kitchen and wash room, a 22' car porch with a 10' NE corner car gate and sloped stone ramp, a 16' x 9' north verandah with recessed manicured lawn court, a 15' x 16' Home ICU with 7' north slider and 5'6" clear west opening, living hall, drawing room, caregiver suite, master suite, and an open-plan kitchen with a wide 2'9" (840 mm) east-wall quartz platform beneath two east windows, full under-counter sage-teal storage, minimalist floating shelves, and west-shifted refrigerator/appliance bank. First floor steps back to x=47 ft with symmetrical 3.5' atrium bridges, a 389 sq ft master suite, study/meditation room, shared bath, and medium bedroom. Second floor steps back to x=44 ft with a 31' x 17' office & TV hall and raised glazed sunroof. All structure, waterproofing, drainage falls, and MEP/medical services are conceptual only and require licensed professional engineering design before construction.
